annotations.text:
وين؟ — map + pin + ؟

Built from the existing mark in src/components/WainLogo.tsx. The Kuwait silhouette and the pin teardrop are byte-identical to it, on all four artboards.

What changed, measured against that file:

• Flat fills instead of gradients, so it holds at 24px.

• The ؟ is redrawn, not copied — arc radius 4.9→5.1, origin 28→27.4, dot r 2→2.05, stroke 3→3.2. Same redraw on all four boards.

• Kuwait carries no white keyline here. The component strokes every edge at 3.5, which is what lets the mark sit on a photo without a container; only Mono's outline version puts an edge back.

• viewBox is cropped tighter: 18 10 84 88 on this board, 22 12 76 78 on the other three, against the component's 14 8 84 92.

Nothing here is wired into the site. If a direction is approved it lands in WainLogo.tsx and public/brand/wain-logo.svg.

THE THEME — the three boards below are GENERATED.

Palette, Type and Surfaces are written by `npm run design:boards` straight from src/app/globals.css and WainLogo.tsx. 52 swatches, 11 type steps, 8 category grounds, every value read rather than retyped.

Do not hand-edit them: `npm run scan` runs design:boards:check and fails if they drift from the theme. Change a token, re-run the script, re-seed.

Surfaces is the one to design against. A mark is judged on the eight category grounds at 40px and 24px — not on white, which is the one background the site almost never gives it.

Three floors are enforced by audit and are not negotiable: text never below 11px, tap targets never below 44px, text fields never below 16px.
